perspectives.summary: Feature spec 1.2.0, acceptance criteria, tests, and traceability now record the approved no-new-Longhorn storage layout, measured database usage, alert thresholds, logical migration, and untouched PVC boundary.
The 5Gi/1Gi/20Gi/temporary-volume plan is defined, but NAS ACL/capacity, off-node backup, target-only restore, and logical migration evidence are not proven.
Hold until source provider cutoff/WAL/artifact closure, exact target identity/RBAC, fresh credential readiness, and retained-PVC protections are evidenced; Codicarium remains unchanged.

consensus_summary: Keep the pipeline at spec. The requested decisions are reconciled, but unresolved source provider, NAS, restore, identity, and fresh-credential evidence remains a hard gate.
open_questions: Can sanitized provider metadata prove shared cutoff/WAL continuity and graph-artifact SHA closure?
Can the approved static NFS path pass ACL/capacity, retention, off-node backup, restore, and logical migration checks?
What exact target OIDC mapping, callback/scopes, ServiceAccount/RBAC, and fresh credential rotation evidence close D-003?
How are unrelated Longhorn resources and historical/retained PVCs proven untouched?
